pairc_owner.text: Welcome to Páirc Café, named for Páirc Uí Chaoimh, the big GAA ground by the Lee. Cork hurlers and footballers play there.
The ground honours Pádraig Ó Caoimh, who ran the GAA for 35 years. He liked a tidy pitch and a tidy report.

pairc_hurler.text: The ball is a sliotar. It is tough as a boot and flies faster than a bus on the Dublin road.
Rule one of hurling is that you duck. Rule two is that there is no rule two.
There's a net out the back and a sliotar in my bag. Five frees at the keeper, if you're brave.
